description: The company dossier: the full unmasked record, the misconduct check (CNIA) done live and the risk traffic light. Paid per company. Read the assembled screening instead of joining these records yourself. Missing checks are not a clean result. This is a screening aid, not an official certificate or a guarantee that a supplier is safe.

cnpj.description: CNPJ without punctuation: 14 digits or the alphanumeric one (12 letters or digits and 2 check digits), such as 12ABC34501DE35.
